prerequisites: The student has followed the course unit Information Security.
Students must have VMWare Workstation and a Kali Linux Virtual Machine installed on their laptop beforehand. Kali Linux Virtual Machine can be downloaded from: https://www.kali.org/downloads/

learning_outcomes.text: Gather valuable information about potential targets through passive and active sources.
Identify, exploit, report, and mitigate complex vulnerabilities.
Understand advanced security issues that can occur at network, infrastructure, or application level.
Understand how hackers can move through a network.
Understand how antivirus works and which techniques can bypass it.

syllabus_topics: Network security, Infrastructure security and patch management
MetaSploit, Lateral Movement and Anti-Virus Evasion
Integrated Capture The Flag with technical challenges about all previous sessions
teaching_methods: Vulnerability analysis on a lab environment

assessment_methods.method: Technical reporting of CTF challenges and assignments from sessions 1-6
Presentation of approach and solutions for the 2 challenges

assessment_rules: The total score is on a 1-20 scale. There is no second examination opportunity and no resit is possible for this course unit. There are no partial transfers for this course unit.
bibliography: Sources provided by the lecturer and various sources on the internet
